blurb: On the National Register of Historic Places as the 63rd Army Air Forces Contract Pilot School (Primary) of Coffee County, Georgia! Originally a part of South Georgia College’s pilot training program, the 63rd Army Air Forces Contract Pilot School was established in response to the demand for pilots during World War II.
